{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only updates doc/files.md by a single line to document the new index file, which merely follows the code change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are purely incidental to adding the new index."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements a new optional index in src/index/txoscriptindex.cpp and modifies src/index/txospenderindex.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces a new `txoscriptindex` that allows querying transaction outputs by script pubkey, directly resolving a major operational pain point dating back to 2013 (#2802, #3652, #6835, #10370, #14053) where external indexers were previously required."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds the getscripthistory RPC method in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and refactors transaction JSON rendering in src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds the `getscripthistory` RPC enabling queries across block heights for script hashes, addresses, and descriptors, filling a significant interface gap that previously forced applications and Electrum servers into running heavy external indexing stacks."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes and test_runner additions exist specifically to validate the new index and RPC rather than test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests specific to an index or RPC belong to those respective categories rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/init.cpp and local index serializers are specific to wiring up the index rather than shared general utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter core shared utilities or node-wide infrastructure."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,

    "leverage": 1
  }
}
